edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute described as [identify the dispute, including any action and case number] (the “Dispute”), subject to the terms of this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing, no later than ten business days after the date on which the last party signs this Agreement. Plaintiff shall provide its wire instructions upon execution. For purposes of this Agreement, “business day” means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or U.S. federal holiday.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before execution of this Agreement. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or claims arising under, or to enforce, this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that disclosure is permitted (a) to their legal counsel, tax advisers, and accountants for advice or compliance purposes, provided those recipients are subject to professional confidentiality duties or agree to maintain confidentiality; (b) as required by applicable law, regulation, court order, or legal process; (c) to governmental, tax, or regulatory authorities for reporting, compliance, or cooperation purposes; and (d) as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to, or cooperation with, a governmental or regulatory authority, or requires prior notice or approval for such reporting or cooperation.
